findings.issue: AES in CBC mode negotiated (AES-128-CBC): prefer an AEAD mode such as AES-GCM
findings.evidence: IKE transform payload advertised AES-128-CBC; CBC requires a separate integrity algorithm and is more error-prone than AES-GCM
IKE transform payload advertised SHA1 for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20

findings.issue: Weak Diffie-Hellman group negotiated: group 5 (1536-bit MODP)
findings.evidence: IKE key exchange payload indicated DH group 5 for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20

findings.issue: Deprecated key exchange protocol in use: IKEv1
findings.evidence: ISAKMP header reported version 1.0 for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20

findings.issue: SA lifetime below the recommended minimum: 120s (< 300s)
findings.evidence: IKE SA lifetime attribute decoded as 120 seconds for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20; excessive rekeying destabilises the tunnel

findings.issue: Transport mode in use for what appears to be a site-to-site SA
findings.evidence: ESP payload structure for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20 is consistent with transport mode; the inner IP header is therefore not protected

findings.issue: Negotiated cipher suite is not in the approved list
findings.evidence: Suite AES-128-CBC/SHA1/DH5 fails the AES-GCM or AES-256 + SHA-256 baseline: cipher AES-128-CBC does not meet the AES-256 minimum for non-AEAD modes
